youtube.title: UNDER THE HOOD
youtube.summary: Graham Hood reflects on his upcoming New Zealand tour and the Sydney COVID Royal Commission event before turning to his central theme: society's shift from disagreement to outright conflict. Drawing on a backstage conversation with the late Charlie Kirk, unease over Australia's political and biosecurity climate and his own past struggles, he makes the case for assertive, compassionate conversation over aggression as the way through deepening social division. youtube.title: JAMES CORBETT
youtube.summary: Paul Brennan is joined by investigative journalist James Corbett, founder of The Corbett Report, to revisit the unresolved questions surrounding the September 11th attacks in 2001, now 25 years on. Moving beyond the physics of that day, Corbett traces the financial links behind the alleged hijackers, the CIA's ties to Al-Qaeda and the neoconservative planning that followed.
